title: Incorporating an Investment Multiplier into DICE Supports More Rapid Decarbonization
abstract: Integrated assessment models (IAMs) assume that economies operate on the efficiency frontier, resulting in hard tradeoffs between decarbonization, consumption, and investment. Meanwhile, Keynesian models recognize that climate investments can increase employment and output today. This paper attempts to bridge these literatures through a simple modification of the most well-known IAM. We review the neoclassical economic assumptions underpinning dynamic integrated climate-economy model (DICE) and incorporate a range of investment multipliers into DICE that reflect economists’ uncertainty about how climate investments affect output. Our results suggest that decarbonization should be undertaken more rapidly than standard DICE recommends and provides support for pathways within the range of 1.5 °C–2 °C for investment multipliers of 0.75 or greater. The addition of an investment multiplier also suggests that rapid decarbonization can lead to faster economic growth.
abstract_zh: 综合评估模型（IAM）假定经济运行于效率前沿，由此导致脱碳、消费与投资之间存在艰难的权衡。与此同时，凯恩斯主义模型认识到，气候投资可以在当下增加就业和产出。本文试图通过对最著名的IAM进行简单修改，以弥合这两类文献之间的差距。我们回顾了动态综合气候-经济模型（DICE）所依据的新古典经济学假设，并在DICE中纳入了一系列投资乘数，以反映经济学家对气候投资如何影响产出的不确定性。我们的结果表明，脱碳应比标准DICE所建议的更快推进；对于投资乘数为0.75或更高的情形，该结果为1.5°C至2°C的升温路径提供了支持。投资乘数的引入也表明，快速脱碳可以带来更快的经济增长。

title: About Face: Seeing Class and Race
Neoliberalism and Climate Change: How the Free Market Myth Has Prevented Climate Action
Returns in the Labor Market: A Nuanced View of Penalties at the Intersection of Race and Gender
The Role of Rebates in Public Support for Carbon Taxes
abstract_zh: 经济学家主张将碳定价作为减少温室气体排放的首要工具。然而，很少有政府采取了足够高的碳税以实现国际减排目标。政治上的挑战可能源于多个方面，包括政策反对者的政治动员、消费者的支付意愿以及许多碳定价方案的累退性，而这些问题可以通过返还（rebate）加以缓解。我们使用一款新颖的碳税计算器，为美国和瑞士居民提供与碳定价政策相关的个性化财务成本与收益估算。我们的结果表明，在不存在政治宣传的情况下，返还通过争取低收入群体的支持，提高了两国公众对碳税的支持度。在美国，我们发现，当包含返还时，样本中的多数人同时支持低碳税（50美元/tCO2）和高碳税（230美元/tCO2）；而在瑞士，公众支持率较低。然而，政策总是会被政治化，当受访者接触到关于碳定价的政治信息时，返还的效果会被削弱甚至消失。

title: Small Farms Smaller Plots: Land Size, Fragmentation, and Productivity in Ethiopia
abstract: African agriculture is often dominated by smallholder farms composed of multiple plots. In policy circles it is often assumed that fragmentation coupled with small farm size is an impediment to increasing yields and thus decreasing poverty and food insecurity. There also exists an influential literature that explores the inverse relationship between farm size and yield. While there are many studies internationally, few have been conducted in Africa. Using an Ethiopian national survey, we explore the relationship between yield, farm size and fragmentation. We find an inverse relationship between farm size and yield, and a positive association between yield and land fragmentation.
abstract_zh: 非洲农业往往以由多块地块组成的小农户为主导。在政策界，人们通常认为，地块分散与农场规模小是提高产量、进而减少贫困和粮食不安全的障碍。关于农场规模与单产之间呈反向关系的研究也颇具影响力。尽管国际上已有大量相关研究，但在非洲开展的研究却很少。我们利用埃塞俄比亚全国性调查，考察了单产、农场规模与地块分散之间的关系。我们发现，农场规模与单产之间呈反向关系，而单产与土地分散程度之间呈正相关。

title: A Question of 'Fit': local perspectives on top-down flood mitigation policies in Vermont
venue: Journal of Environmental Planning and Management
abstract: Despite consensus on the need to adapt to climate change, who should adapt, and how, remain open questions. While local-level actions are essential to adaptation, state and federal governments can play a substantial role in adaptation. In this paper, we investigate local perspectives on state-level flood mitigation policies in Vermont as a means of analysing what leads top-down adaptations to be effective in mobilizing local action. Drawing on interviews with town officials, we delineate local-level perspectives on Vermont's top-down policies and use those perspectives to develop a conceptual framework that presents the ‘fit’ between top-down policies and the local-level context as comprised of three components: Receptivity, Ease of Participation, and Design. We explain how these components and their interactions influence local-level action. This analysis points to how careful consideration of the components of ‘fit’ may lead to greater local-level uptake of top-down adaptation policies.
abstract_zh: 尽管人们一致认为需要适应气候变化，但由谁来适应以及如何适应，仍是悬而未决的问题。虽然地方层面的行动对适应至关重要，但州政府和联邦政府也能在适应中发挥重要作用。本文以佛蒙特州的州级洪水减灾政策为案例，考察地方层面的看法，以分析何种自上而下的适应措施能够有效动员地方行动。基于对镇政府官员的访谈，我们梳理了地方层面对佛蒙特州自上而下政策的看法，并利用这些看法构建了一个概念框架，将自上而下的政策与地方情境之间的“契合度”（fit）概括为三个组成部分：接受度（Receptivity）、参与的便利性（Ease of Participation）和政策设计（Design）。我们阐释了这些组成部分及其相互作用如何影响地方行动。该分析表明，审慎考虑“契合度”的各个组成部分，可能有助于提高地方对自上而下适应政策的采纳程度。
